expect.stdout: {"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Varlatch guardrail: this search would print lines of .env files, so their values would enter your context. To see the names a .env file sets, run `varlatch --assisted import --dry-run <file>`."}}
